report:
Reviewed the complete local_index_firewall claim and both associated TODO entries; captured the solver design, architectural-foundations local-index discussion and the current local_impl_candidates source. Source inspection only; no tests rerun and no source edits.

The destination requires a stable crate-owned index identity, private tracked map, exclusively keyed tracked reading and an equal trait-bucket backdating boundary before header lowering/solving/normalization/body work. It permits cheap map/lookup reexecution but excludes impl-body changes from signature buckets. The explicit implementation TODO correctly states this private index/firewall is not implemented. The captured current local_impl_candidates is tracked and trait-keyed, but recursively scans expanded module items, reads impl CST/trait identity and selected signatures, and accumulates completeness during that scan. It returns a vector plus completeness, not a stable tracked index with a private map and separate cheap bucket lookup. Therefore its present memoization does not satisfy the claimed pre-header-lowering firewall and is not treated as one.

The sole solver_local_index_firewall test is explicitly TODO and has no assertions. It requires persistent edits distinguishing index rebuild, keyed lookup, header lowering, canonical solving, normalization and body execution; unrelated-trait/impl-body edits stopping at equal lookup; relevant/global-hazard edits invalidating permitted consumers; and stable identity across unrelated edits. The prerequisite is implementing the private index and bucket boundary before building and reviewing that event/edit matrix. Every requirement is represented in the implementation/evidence deferral, rather than silently waived or inferred from the existing tracked scanner. No ordinary coverage is claimed. These honest explicit deferrals need no additional edits in this review.
